name: ab_device_poses_replay_2k
notes: CUDA plan item 5 on a fixed ACE stream (replay of experiments/recordings/drone_continuous_2k.arrows, recorded run 21.12 dB): baseline = replay only (noise floor with ACE pinned); device_a1 = device pose table, no filter (parity); filter_a03 = SO(3)xR3 EMA gain 0.3 on relocalization jitter; +tiers = stability-weighted sampling. Re-scoped after filter_a03 r0 (-1.0 dB): relocalization moves are mostly drift, not jitter (innovation vs filtered pose 8.7% median vs 2.5% unfiltered), so the EMA lags the map and misaligns train vs held-out cameras. Filter arms dropped; tiers tested alone (alpha 1).
